[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#<color=#be6106>Press <dynamicsprite=[keymouse_img:M]></color>, or open][LAYOUT_TOUCH#Open] Map on your Phone to <color=#be6106>track creatures</color>.

get_tutorialcontent:
In <color=#be6106>Cliff Mode</color> or <color=#be6106>Water Mode</color>, you can reshape the landscape.
1. Cliffs can be built up to <color=#be6106>8 layers</color>.
2. For every three layers added, the cliff recedes inward by one tile.
3. Waterfalls can only be created along the middle section of a cliff.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Planetmaker

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Today's Greenmarket is a marketplace for crop purchases, and multiple planets may be randomly assigned to different markets.
2. The crop purchase list changes periodically.
3. Each time the purchase list refreshes, the market resets and all planets are reassigned to new markets.
4. Each planet's daily crop yield collectively affects demand in the Greenmarket, which in turn influences purchase prices.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Today's Greenmarket

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Purchase prices at Today's Greenmarket are influenced by the crop yields of all planets in the same market from the previous day.
2. Prices are the same within the same market.
3. Supply and demand apply: when a crop's yield was high yesterday, its market demand decreases, and today's price drops. Conversely, when yesterday's yield was low, today's price rises.
4. At <color=#be6106>12:00</color> and <color=#be6106>20:00</color> daily, purchase prices are updated based on the latest yields.
5. If you can predict which crops are grown in smaller quantities in the current market, you are more likely to sell them at higher prices tomorrow.
get_tutorialgroupname: How can I predict market prices?

get_tutorialcontent: Crop purchase lists and prices may vary between planets. Head to the <color=#be6106>Galactic Bazaar</color>, check the <color=#be6106>Market Message Board</color>, or use <color=#be6106>Yoohoo</color> to visit other planets and trade at their Greenmarkets.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I compare prices?

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Once you unlock Today's Greenmarket, the crops in demand will change periodically.
2. Crops harvested while they're in demand count as Fresh Harvest.
3. Crops harvested when they're not in demand will sell for less at the Greenmarket.
4. Sell Fresh Harvest while it's still in demand to earn more.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Fresh Harvest

<color=#be6106>Hold</color> the furniture, then <color=#be6106>drag</color> to place it where you want.

get_tutorialcontent:
<color=#be6106>Blueprints</color> let you quickly decorate your planet by placing the required items with a single [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click], making planet building a breeze.
There are currently three types of Blueprints: <color=#be6106>Template, Custom</color>, and <color=#be6106>Saved</color>.
Under <color=#be6106>Templates</color>, select a Blueprint and gather the required items. Then, enter Planetmaker to place them on your planet.
To create a new <color=#be6106>Custom</color> Blueprint, open Planetmaker, select multiple items you've already placed, and save them as a custom Blueprint.
In <color=#be6106>MiniCorner</color>, you can browse custom Blueprints shared by other players and <color=#be6106>save</color> them. Saved Blueprints can then be used to decorate your planet.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Blueprints

get_tutorialgroupname: How do I cook?

get_tutorialcontent:
In <color=#be6106>Recipes</color>, you can preview dishes you haven't learned yet. Use each dish's name and image as clues to figure out the required ingredients and cooking appliance. Discover the correct combination to master the dish.
Even if your attempt fails, the ingredients will be returned, so you can keep trying.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I cook using a recipe?

get_tutorialcontent:
In <color=#be6106>Freestyle Mode</color>, you can freely combine ingredients, choose different kitchen appliances, and experiment to discover new dishes.
Once you successfully create a new dish, you'll learn it and be able to cook it directly in Recipe Mode.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I cook using Freestyle Mode?

get_tutorialcontent: Dish quality is also closely tied to ingredient quality. For example, to make a <color=#be6106>Golden Stellar-quality</color> dish, at least one ingredient must be of <color=#be6106>Golden Stellar</color> quality.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Dish Quality

get_tutorialcontent: As your cooking skill improves, you may cook dishes with special effects.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Dish Effects

get_tutorialcontent: Some dishes grant special effects when eaten. [LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] to view dish details.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Dish Effects

get_tutorialcontent:
Each Inspo Card contains the recipe for a specific piece of furniture.
Open your Backpack and <color=#be6106>get inspiration</color> from an Inspo Card to learn how to craft the furniture and what materials you'll need.
Once you have the required materials, head to the <color=#be6106>DIY Bench</color> to craft it.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use an Inspo Card?
How do I use an Inspo Card?

get_tutorialcontent:
Inspo Cards are stored in the <color=#be6106>InspoBox</color>.
There, you can browse sets, preview <color=#be6106>designs</color>, and see <color=#be6106>how to obtain</color> them.
Approach a DIY Bench and [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] <color=#be6106>Craft</color>, or open <color=#be6106>InspoBox</color> on your Phone to view.
get_tutorialgroupname: About InspoBox

get_tutorialcontent:
After opening <color=#be6106>InspoBox</color> on your Phone, [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] <color=#be6106>Theme Mode</color> to browse sets by theme.
<color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] an Inspo Card Set</color> to view its contents, preview <color=#be6106>designs</color>, and see <color=#be6106>how to obtain</color> them.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I view Inspo Card Sets by theme?

get_tutorialcontent: As you learn more recipes and master them, you'll unlock more recipes to explore. Dishes you cook will also restore more <color=#be6106>Strength</color> and sell for <color=#be6106>higher prices</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: Discover More Recipes
How do I use the Paint Roller?

get_tutorialcontent:
Select the Paint Roller from the <color=#be6106>Tool Wheel</color>.
With the Paint Roller equipped, choose a path style and <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_LeftMouse.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the paint roller button]</color> on an empty area to paint.
Different ways of painting will shape corners and edges differently.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use the Paint Roller?

get_tutorialcontent: Some Vignettes can only be placed on the beach. When setting one up, make sure the entire layout stays within the beach area.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I choose where to set up a Vignette?

get_tutorialcontent:
Some Vignettes have special placement requirements and need to be aligned with the water.
When setting them up, position the areas marked with the wave icon over the water. Unmarked areas should be placed against land.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I choose where to set up a Vignette?

get_tutorialcontent:
1. [LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] <color=#be6106>Set Up</color>.
2. Place the required items in the designated spots within the selected area.
3. Meet the <color=#be6106>requirements</color> to complete the setup.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I set up a Vignette?

get_tutorialcontent:
Wall- and ceiling-mounted furniture must be placed near a wall or ceiling.
Move close to a <color=#be6106>wall</color> for <color=#be6106>wall-mounted</color> items, and close to a <color=#be6106>ceiling</color> for <color=#be6106>ceiling-mounted</color> items.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I place furniture?

get_tutorialcontent:
To set up a Vignette, first choose a suitable location.
After selecting Set Up, you can see the Vignette's setup area and placement guides.
"Show Placement Guides" is on by default and can be turned off manually.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I choose where to set up a Vignette?
How do I place furniture?

get_tutorialcontent:
When the Luca Arbor levels up, your planet will grow <color=#be6106>new environments</color> and unlock <color=#be6106>new features</color>.
Complete Luca Arbor tasks to collect <color=#be6106>Luca</color>, and use it to grow the Luca Arbor.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I level up the Luca Arbor?

get_tutorialcontent:
At cliffs, you can use <color=#be6106>inclines</color> to create pathways.
Take out an incline from your Backpack, choose a suitable spot, and [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] <color=#be6106>Confirm</color> to place it.
You can rotate and move it to find the best position.
The higher end of the incline must be placed into the cliff to be positioned correctly.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use bridges or inclines?

get_tutorialcontent:
At cliffs or rivers, you can use <color=#be6106>bridges</color> to create pathways.
Take out a bridge from your Backpack, choose a suitable spot, and [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] <color=#be6106>Confirm</color> to place it.
You can rotate and move it to find the best position.
Both ends of the bridge must connect to riverbanks or cliffs.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use bridges or inclines?

get_tutorialcontent:
A coordination minigame where you guess your Neighbor's Reaction.
Your Neighbor will secretly choose a Reaction, and you'll have three chances to guess which one they picked. Guess correctly once to win.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Guess the Reaction

get_tutorialcontent:
Once a Neighbor settles in, the Shared Diary in Starcove will become available.
1. On special milestones and during heartwarming moments together, your Neighbor may write down their thoughts and share them with you.
2. As you spend time together, you can also record memorable moments, your Neighbor's charming little quirks, and new things you discover about them.
get_tutorialgroupname: About the Shared Diary

get_tutorialcontent: Clothing that can be worn by Neighbors is marked with a special icon. Select an item to check its size. Different sizes fit different Neighbor body types, and these items can also be given as daily gifts.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I check Neighbor clothing sizes?

get_tutorialcontent: Most Neighbor clothing has a matching version for Planet Tenders. Check the details of clothing you own or the Omnidex to see if there's a matching Neighbor version.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I find Neighbor versions of clothing I own?

get_tutorialcontent:
A classic minigame of Rock-Paper-Scissors.
You and your Neighbor choose Rock, Paper, or Scissors at the same time. Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock, and Rock beats Scissors. Win two out of three rounds to claim the overall victory.
If you both choose the same move in a round, the round ends in a tie. Multiple ties may trigger a special reaction from your Neighbor.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Rock-Paper-Scissors

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Neighbor clothing can be purchased with Neighbor Outfit Tokens. You can earn plenty of Neighbor Outfit Tokens by trading in duplicate or unwanted clothing
2. If you're short on Neighbor Outfit Tokens, you can use Dough to cover the difference. Neighbor versions of clothing you already own are usually cheaper.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I buy clothing for Neighbors?

get_tutorialcontent:
During your Starsea Voyage, you can <color=#be6106>select Neighbors to travel with</color>.
Select a Neighbor to view their strengths and weaknesses.
Neighbors won't perform actions they struggle with. [LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] a selected Neighbor to remove them from your companions.
Choosing the right Neighbor can improve your efficiency in gathering materials.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I explore the Starsea with Neighbors?

get_tutorialcontent:
When you land on an unexplored Islet in the Starsea, you may meet a new Neighbor and exchange Starcove contact info.
Keep traveling, and meeting that Neighbor again will increase your Bond.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I meet new Neighbors in the Starsea?

get_tutorialcontent: During your Starsea Voyage, you can select a Neighbor from the Hang Out list to have them <color=#be6106>roam freely</color>, <color=#be6106>stay put</color>, <color=#be6106>follow closely</color>, or <color=#be6106>gather resources</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I issue Hang Out Commands to a Neighbor during a Starsea Voyage?

get_tutorialcontent:
"Expert" indicates the Neighbor's strongest ability. During Starsea Voyages, the Neighbor will perform tasks in this area more efficiently.
"Enthusiast" indicates an ability the Neighbor is fairly skilled at. During Starsea Voyages, the Neighbor will often perform actions related to this ability.
"Struggles With" indicates something the Neighbor won't attempt at all.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I find out what a Neighbor is good at?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Crop Garden is a special field Yunguo set up using her Granny's tried-and-true farming methods.
1. Once activated, Yunguo will tend the crops here for you.
2. Add seeds to the <color=#be6106>Seed Box</color>, and Yunguo will take care of the planting.
3. Check the scarecrow to see how your crops are doing.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I help Yunguo set up the Crop Garden?

get_tutorialcontent:
A coordination minigame where you guess your Neighbor's Reaction.
Your Neighbor will secretly choose a Reaction, and you'll have three chances to guess which one they picked. Guess correctly once to win.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Guess the Reaction

get_tutorialcontent: When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches <color=#be6106>Level 2</color>, you can <color=#be6106>invite them to your planet</color> via Starcove. Daily invites are limited.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to visit my planet?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Neighbor Wardrobe is a clothing shop exclusively for you and your Neighbors.
1. It offers clothing inspired by the latest trends.
2. It also regularly features Neighbor versions of clothing you already own.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Neighbor Wardrobe

get_tutorialcontent:
A coordination minigame where you guess your Neighbor's Reaction.
Your Neighbor will secretly choose a Reaction, and you'll have three chances to guess which one they picked. Guess correctly once to win.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Guess the Reaction

get_tutorialcontent:
A fruit-themed tic-tac-toe minigame.
At the start of the game, nine blank cards will appear. You and your Neighbor will each be assigned a different fruit, then take turns selecting blank cards to turn them into cards showing your fruit.
Your Neighbor always goes first. The first to line up three of their fruit cards wins. If all nine cards have been filled and neither side has completed a line, you win.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Tic-Tac-Toe

get_tutorialcontent:
A matching-card minigame where you look for pairs with the same number.
At the start of the game, 12 cards will appear face down. You and your Neighbor take turns choosing two cards at a time. If the two cards have the same number, you earn 1 point and both cards remain face up. If the numbers are different, you earn no points and the cards are turned face down again.
The first to reach 3 points wins the game.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Number Match

get_tutorialcontent: During a hangout, the Neighbor will follow you into different locations.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite someone to other locations?

get_tutorialcontent: Once the puzzle has been presented, the Neighbor will ask a random question. Answer correctly to win.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Truth or Lie

get_tutorialcontent:
A memory and deduction minigame.
The Neighbor will present you with a logic puzzle, and you'll need to use the clues to figure out who's telling the truth and who's lying.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Truth or Lie

get_tutorialcontent: Once the memorization time is over, your Neighbor will randomly give you a question or challenge based on the items shown on the cards. Answer correctly or complete the challenge without mistakes to win. If you answer incorrectly or make a mistake during the challenge, your Neighbor wins.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Memory Cards

get_tutorialcontent:
A memory-testing minigame.
At the start of each round, nine cards will appear, with different items randomly arranged on them.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Memory Cards

get_tutorialcontent:
If both of you choose the same Reaction, your Neighbor wins the round. If you choose different Reactions, you win the round.
The first to <style=Highlight>win two rounds</style> in a row wins the match.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Mismatch to Win

get_tutorialcontent:
A card minigame where you compare numbers with a Neighbor.
At the start of the game, nine face-down cards numbered 1 through 9 will appear.
Each round, you and your Neighbor each choose a card in the agreed order, then reveal them at the same time. Whoever has the higher number wins the round and earns 1 point. The first to reach 2 points wins the game.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Higher or Lower

get_tutorialcontent:
A coordination minigame where you perform Reactions together with a Neighbor.
At the start of each round, three Reactions will be shown. You and your Neighbor each choose one, then perform your selected Reactions together.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Mismatch to Win

get_tutorialcontent: [test] This game is not yet available.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Acting Showcase

get_tutorialcontent: [test] This game is not yet available.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Codebreaker

get_tutorialcontent: [test] This game is not yet available.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Number Bomb

get_tutorialcontent: A mini-game to test your luck against a Neighbor. At the start of the game, nine face-down cards numbered 1 through 9 will appear. Your Neighbor will choose a lucky number, and after deciding who goes first, you and your Neighbor take turns flipping over cards. The first to reveal the card with the lucky number wins.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Lucky Number

get_tutorialcontent: After the story ends, the Neighbor will ask a random question about one of the key details. Answer correctly to win.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Memory Challenge

get_tutorialcontent:
A memory-testing minigame.
The Neighbor will tell you a short story with a few key details hidden within it.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Memory Challenge

get_tutorialcontent: [test] This game is not yet available.
get_tutorialgroupname: Neighbor Minigame: Cyber Combat

get_tutorialcontent: When hanging out with a Neighbor, use the <color=#be6106>Point</color> Reaction to guide them to a specific location.
get_tutorialgroupname: Hang Out Commands: Pointing

get_tutorialcontent:
[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] the <color=#be6106>"-" icon</color> to remove that Neighbor from the shot.
You can also <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#press <dynamicsprite=[keymouse_img:Escape]>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the exit button]</color> to exit camera mode.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I stop taking photos with Neighbors?

get_tutorialcontent: When hanging out with a Neighbor, you can have them <color=#be6106>roam freely</color>, <color=#be6106>stay put</color>, <color=#be6106>follow closely</color>, or <color=#be6106>gather resources</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: Hang Out Commands: Basic Instructions

get_tutorialcontent:
The number of days your Friendship Flower has been in bloom with a Neighbor will be tracked and can be viewed in the pop-up.
You can also check the details of how the Friendship Flower has been watered there.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I grow a Friendship Flower with a Neighbor?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Friendship Flower has three growth stages.
Chatting with your Neighbor, giving them gifts, and other interactions will help water the Friendship Flower.
Once it has been watered for the required number of days, the Friendship Flower will evolve to the next stage.
On the other hand, if your Bond does not increase for a long time, the Friendship Flower will regress.
Be sure to interact with your Neighbor often!
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I grow a Friendship Flower with a Neighbor?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Friendship Flower is a symbol of your bond with a Neighbor.
Once your Bond with a Neighbor reaches Lv. 8, you can begin growing your Friendship Flower together.
get_tutorialgroupname: Friendship Flowers with Neighbors

get_tutorialcontent:
When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches the current level cap, fulfill the <color=#be6106>upgrade conditions</color> to raise the Bond level.
You can view the <color=#be6106>upgrade conditions</color> in <color=#be6106>Starcove</color>.
You can also check the quest marked with the <color=#be6106>Bond icon</color> in the Neighbor Memo. Complete it <color=#be6106>to level up your Bond</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I increase a Neighbor's Bond level?

get_tutorialcontent:
You can also increase Bond by completing Neighbor requests.
In the <color=#be6106>Neighbor Memo</color>, look for quests that reward Bond. Completing them will increase your Bond.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I raise my Bond with a Neighbor?

get_tutorialcontent: In Starcove, you can view your Neighbors' gift <color=#be6106>preferences</color>. Giving gifts they <color=#be6106>love</color> or <color=#be6106>like</color> grants extra Bond, while gifts they <color=#be6106>dislike</color> will be returned.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I raise my Bond with a Neighbor?

get_tutorialcontent:
When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches <color=#be6106>Level 3</color>, you can invite them to live on your planet.
Talk to them and select the option to <color=#be6106>invite them to settle</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to settle in?

get_tutorialcontent:
Chatting with Neighbors, giving gifts, and completing their requests all increase Bond.
Your first chat with a Neighbor each day also grants Bond.
You can give one gift per Neighbor each day, and different gifts grant different amounts.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I raise my Bond with a Neighbor?

get_tutorialcontent: Each interaction with your Neighbors is recorded as a <color=#be6106>log</color>. In these logs, you can view your gift and conversation history with them.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Log

get_tutorialcontent:
Spending time with a Neighbor will build up your shared <color=#be6106>journey</color>.
Each milestone along the way brings rewards. Together, these moments form a constellation, lighting up your Neighbor's sky.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Journey

get_tutorialcontent:
In Starcove, you can also view your Neighbors' <color=#be6106>profiles</color>.
Their profiles include your current <color=#be6106>Bond</color>, their <color=#be6106>preferences</color>, and more.
Give gifts to discover their preferences, and as your bond deepens, you may uncover more about them.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I view a Neighbor's profile?

get_tutorialcontent: <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click]</color> to enter a Neighbor's Planette and view their <color=#be6106>Story</color>, <color=#be6106>Journey</color>, <color=#be6106>Log</color>, <color=#be6106>Profile</color>, and <color=#be6106>Growth</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I view a Neighbor's Planette?

get_tutorialcontent: You can view the Neighbors you've exchanged contacts with in <color=#be6106>Starcove</color> on your Phone. Each Neighbor has their own <color=#be6106>Planette</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I view a Neighbor's Planette?

get_tutorialcontent: When a Neighbor is nearby furniture during a hangout, you can have them interact with it.
get_tutorialgroupname: Hang Out Commands: Interact With Furniture

get_tutorialcontent:
Starcove records your current <color=#be6106>Bond level</color> with each Neighbor.
As your Bond level increases, more interactions and events become available, and your conversations grow deeper.
To increase your Bond level, you can <color=#be6106>chat</color> with them daily and give them <color=#be6106>gifts</color> to find out their preferences.
Giving <color=#be6106>gifts they like</color> grants additional <color=#be6106>Bond</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Bond Level

get_tutorialcontent:
Once a Neighbor agrees to settle down, collect their <color=#be6106>Building Kit</color> from <color=#be6106>Mobai</color>.
Place it on your planet. They'll move in once it's complete.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to settle in?

get_tutorialcontent:
As you grow closer to your Neighbors, you'll gradually learn more about their <color=#be6106>stories</color>.
Read them to receive <color=#be6106>gifts</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I learn about a Neighbor's story?

get_tutorialcontent:
Once a Neighbor agrees to settle down, collect their <color=#be6106>Building Kit</color> from <color=#be6106>Mobai</color>.
Place it on your planet. They'll move in once it's complete.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to settle in?

get_tutorialcontent:
When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches <color=#be6106>Level 3</color>, you can invite them to live on your planet.
Talk to them and select the option to <color=#be6106>invite them to settle</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to settle in?

get_tutorialcontent:
When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches <color=#be6106>Level 7</color>, you can invite them to hang out.
When talking to a Neighbor, select <color=#be6106>"Got a minute?"</color> or a similar option to invite them along. They will follow you anywhere on the planet.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to hang out?

get_tutorialcontent:
Clothing gifted to a Neighbor will be added to their wardrobe.
They'll open their Backpack so you can personally choose an outfit for them.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I suggest outfits to Neighbors?

get_tutorialcontent: Get more decorating ideas from Homi Decor tips.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I increase Neighbor satisfaction in Homi Decor?

get_tutorialcontent:
Satisfaction is evaluated based on three criteria, each with its own cap:
1. Comfort: Based on furniture rarity, harmony, and variety.
2. Style Preference: Grants bonus points based on the Neighbor's preferred styles in the Preferred list.
3. Additional Furniture: Grants bonus points for extra furniture requested in the Preferred list.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I increase Neighbor satisfaction in Homi Decor?

get_tutorialcontent:
In Homi Decor, the design request lists all required furniture.
[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] the furniture list to quickly filter matching items.
[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] the <color=#be6106>Backpack filters</color> to filter furniture from your Backpack, your Neighbor's, or both.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I filter furniture in Homi Decor?

get_tutorialcontent: Place furniture that matches your Neighbor's style preferences to earn higher satisfaction.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I help Neighbors decorate their homes?

get_tutorialcontent: When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches <color=#be6106>Level 5</color>, talk to them and choose <color=#be6106>"Got a minute?"</color> or a similar option and <color=#be6106>suggest an outfit</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I suggest outfits to Neighbors?

get_tutorialcontent:
Listen to the Neighbor's ideas for their home design, then open Homi Decor on your phone to accept their design request.
After completing the decoration, you'll receive thank-you gifts based on their <color=#be6106>satisfaction</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Homi Decor

get_tutorialcontent:
When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches <color=#be6106>Level 6</color>, go to <color=#be6106>Mobai</color> to install <color=#be6106>Homi Decor</color> on your phone.
After helping a <color=#be6106>Neighbor upgrade their house</color>, they will post a Homi Decor request.
Fulfill the Neighbor's decor request to increase their satisfaction and receive gifts.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Homi Decor

get_tutorialcontent:
You can help a Neighbor upgrade their house <color=#be6106>the day after learning about Neighbor Vignettes</color>.
Listen to the Neighbor's wishes about their home to obtain their <color=#be6106>House Blueprint</color>.
Talk to Mobai and select <color=#be6106>Housing Services</color>, then accept the Neighbor's house order to help upgrade their home.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I help a Neighbor upgrade their house?

get_tutorialcontent:
When your <color=#be6106>Bond</color> with a Neighbor reaches <color=#be6106>Level 4</color>, you can invite them to take photos together.
Open the Camera, then [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] the <color=#be6106>photo invite</color> button to invite nearby idle Neighbors to join the photo.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to take a photo together?

get_tutorialcontent:
In Homi Decor, the <color=#be6106>Required</color> list shows the items needed for the design. You must submit these furniture pieces to complete the request.
The <color=#be6106>Preferred</color> list shows your Neighbor's preferences. Submitting these items grants a higher rating.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I help Neighbors decorate their homes?

get_tutorialcontent:
You can invite up to 6 Neighbors to take photos together.
[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] the <color=#be6106>"+" button</color> to choose suitable photo Reactions for them.
You can also switch camera angles to adjust the shot.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite a Neighbor to take a photo together?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Bazaar Jelly Special is a popular drink in the Bazaar, awarded as a <color=#be6106>Gold Prize</color> item from Civilla's Hat-Trick Magic Wheel.
After drinking it, you can earn Bazaar Jellies by bumping into others for a limited time.
Take a sip, bump around, and party in the Galactic Bazaar!
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I drink the Bazaar Jelly Special?

get_tutorialcontent: You can also [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] any character's speech bubble to open the chat history panel.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I view chat history?

get_tutorialcontent: When the chat box is open, [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] the chat history button to bring up the chat history panel.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I view chat history?

get_tutorialcontent: Find the Bazaar Help Sign in your Backpack and complete its design. Then hold it up in the Bazaar to invite others to visit your planet.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use the Bazaar Help Sign?

get_tutorialcontent: In Riffe's carefully prepared Story Soup, she reveals the ending of a mysterious tale. Participants seated around the bonfire may <color=#be6106>ask Riffe questions</color> to piece together the "ingredients" of the soup — revealing the full story.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I join Riffe's Story Soup?

get_tutorialcontent:
Take a seat by the bonfire to join Riffe's Storytime activities.
Storytime activities include games like Story Soup, Word Chain, and Story Circle. Join in the fun to earn <color=#be6106>Bazaar Jellies</color>.
The daily limit for earning Bazaar Jellies is shared across all Bazaar events.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I join Riffe's Storytime by the bonfire?

get_tutorialcontent:
During event hours, if no one is currently participating in Pitch & Profit on stage, you can sign up with Aleo.
If a session is already in progress on stage, you can sign up at Aleo's sign-up board below the stage.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I sign up for Pitch & Profit?

get_tutorialcontent: [LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] the <color=#be6106>Pitch Idea</color> button next to the input box to quickly brainstorm and fire off your pitch. Keep dropping witty lines to build up your Wit. Max it out to land a <color=#be6106>Punchline</color> and boost the item's Wit Premium.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I increase the Wit Premium of my item?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Shapeshifting Special is a widely popular drink in the Bazaar, awarded as a <color=#be6106>Silver Prize</color> item from Civilla's Hat-Trick Magic Wheel.
After drinking it, you will transform into a unique object for a limited time.
Moving will revert you to your original form.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I drink the Shapeshifting Special?

get_tutorialcontent:
After you finish speaking, Aleo will evaluate the <color=#be6106>Wit Premium of your submitted item</color> and award rewards based on your performance.
You can earn <color=#be6106>Dough</color> once per day from Pitch & Profit, and the daily limit for Bazaar Jellies is shared across all Bazaar events.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I claim the Pitch & Profit rewards?

get_tutorialcontent:
1. In Word-Guessing Soup, players choose the theme. If no one picks one, Riffe will decide.
2. Riffe will describe the answer through a short Story Soup, then players take turns asking questions and trying to guess the word.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I join Riffe's Word-Guessing Soup?

get_tutorialcontent:
StarDash is an essential lifestyle app in the Starsea, bringing convenience to planet life while offering rewards to those who take on deliveries.
In <color=#be6106>StarDash</color>, you can accept orders from Neighbors on your own planet or other planets across the Starsea.
Rewards vary by order, and there is a daily limit to how many orders you can accept.
Orders refresh periodically, and higher-paying orders may appear.
get_tutorialgroupname: About StarDash

get_tutorialcontent: Drag one of your cards out to play it. Try different card effects to gain the upper hand and win.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I play Amira?

get_tutorialcontent: When visiting a friend's planet, you can place your prepared gift on their Gift Table.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I give gifts during a visit?

get_tutorialcontent: You can also give gifts to friends in person. Hold a gift from your Backpack, then [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] [LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#<dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_LeftMouse.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#the button] to hand it over.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I give gifts during a visit?

get_tutorialcontent:
Interact with the <color=#be6106>Welcome Gift Stand</color> to place <color=#be6106>Welcome Gifts</color>.
Visitors can claim their gifts here when they arrive on your planet.
You can set claim permissions in <color=#be6106>Station Management</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I prepare welcome gifts for visitors?

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Head to the Star Station and select <color=#be6106>Switch Channel</color> to move to a different Bazaar channel.
2. Livelier Bazaar channels have more people, while quieter ones offer a more peaceful atmosphere.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I switch Bazaar channels?

get_tutorialcontent:
Amira is a popular card game among travelers at the Bazaar.
1. At the Galactic Bazaar, find an Amira table and [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] <color=#be6106>Play</color> to start or join a game of Amira.
2. After playing several times, you can redeem an Amira table at the Prize Kiosk. Place it to start a game anytime.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I play Amira?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Epistolarian's Desk is a special piece of furniture for sending and reading Star Notes.
1. Star Notes you send will travel to a random planet, where they may be found and answered by someone you've never met.
2. Use the Epistolarian's Desk to send Star Notes, share heartfelt thoughts, and bring a little more warmth to the Starsea.
3. You can also reply to Star Notes from strangers on your own planet. Please keep your messages friendly and respectful.
get_tutorialgroupname: About the Epistolarian's Desk

get_tutorialcontent:
The Vibe Beacon records the impressions visitors leave on a planet.
When visiting a planet, you can like it, leave a message, or share an impression at the Vibe Beacon. These interactions contribute to the planet's Popularity.
The impressions it receives and the planet's Popularity will change the Vibe Beacon's appearance.
get_tutorialgroupname: About the Vibe Beacon

get_tutorialcontent:
Popularity reflects the social activity and growth of a planet.
When visitors come to your planet, interactions with the Vibe Beacon, such as likes, messages, and impressions, will increase its Popularity.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Popularity

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Attract more visitors to your planet or have them stay longer.
2. Receive more likes and messages.
3. Interact more with visitors on your planet by chatting, taking photos, giving flowers, becoming Starsea Friends, and inviting them to use Reactions.
4. Visitor activities such as gathering materials, trading at Glenn's shop or the Trading Rack, visiting your home, leaving gifts, or watering crops will also increase Popularity.
※ Some social activities have a daily limit. Once the limit is reached, further activity of that type will no longer count toward that day's Popularity.
※ Popularity is updated at 6:00 the following day.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I increase Popularity?

get_tutorialcontent: Once you become Friends, you can follow them in multiplayer areas.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Friend Follow

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Aleo hosts Pitch & Profit daily at <color=#be6106>specific times</color>, with a different theme each day.
2. Submit items to Aleo to participate. Based on your submission and your <color=#be6106>pitch</color>, he will decide whether to raise or lower the purchase price.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Pitch & Profit

get_tutorialcontent: During Friend Follow, you'll <color=#be6106>earn bonus Footprints</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Friend Follow

get_tutorialcontent: Accept StarDash orders and complete deliveries to improve your Delivery Skill. As it levels up, you'll unlock new abilities.
get_tutorialgroupname: About StarDash

get_tutorialcontent:
Flowers you have can be <color=#be6106>given</color> to others.
Select and hold a flower from your Backpack, then <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_LeftMouse.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the button]</color> to offer it.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I give flowers to other players?

get_tutorialcontent:
The <color=#be6106>Bazaar Guide</color> is your go-to source for event info in the Galactic Bazaar.
Complete the <color=#be6106>Bazaar Peel Palooza</color> to earn a <color=#be6106>Bazaar Gift Box</color>.
Use the tabs on the left side of the Bazaar Guide to view ongoing events.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Bazaar Guide

get_tutorialcontent:
As your bond with a Friend deepens, you can become each other's most cherished and important Close Friend across the Starsea.
On the <color=#be6106>Friend</color> tab, [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] the <color=#be6106>star</color> button in the top-right corner to view your interaction details.
<color=#be6106>Interact</color> with a Friend enough times to become <color=#be6106>Close Friends</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Close Friends

get_tutorialcontent:
In the Galactic Bazaar, <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#press <dynamicsprite=[keymouse_img:Return]>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the chat box button]</color> to open the chat box.
You can chat with others and see their messages when you are friends, sitting next to each other, or at the same table.
You can also chat with strangers in open chat zones such as the campfire area and the Help Hub.
Chat messages are not visible between strangers.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I chat with others?

get_tutorialcontent:
In multiplayer areas like the Galactic Bazaar, find someone you'd like to connect with and <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click]</color> the friend button above their head to send a friend request.
When you receive a friend request, accept it in <color=#be6106>Yoohoo</color> to become friends.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I add friends nearby?

get_tutorialcontent:
[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] <color=#be6106>Interact</color> in Yoohoo to invite a friend to your location or travel to theirs.
When visiting each other, [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] the <color=#be6106>Multiplayer Management</color> button to manage your session.
From there, you can end the session or return home.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I invite someone to meet up?

get_tutorialcontent:
To become Close Friends, you need to head to the Galactic Bazaar.
There, send a Close Friend request to your Friend, <color=#be6106>light up the Star Lights</color>, step closer, and wait for them to accept.
Once both of you have lit the Star Lights, you'll become Close Friends.
Close Friends are prioritized in your Yoohoo Friend list. In your intertwined skies, an interactive space opens between your planets, creating a special place to store all your shared memories.
[LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Click] the <color=#be6106>Close Friend Space</color> button to view the memories you've created with your Close Friend.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I become Close Friends with a Friend?

get_tutorialcontent:
The cafe is divided into public rooms and private rooms.
In a <color=#be6106>public room</color>, you can chat with everyone in the cafe, while <color=#be6106>private rooms</color> are created by the host and can only be accessed by invited friends.
Invite friends to private rooms through <color=#be6106>Yoohoo</color>, or they can request to join through it.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Cafe Rooms

get_tutorialcontent:
In the cafe, <color=#be6106>sit at the counter</color> to order a coffee you like.
Talk to the barista, Nalo, if you'd like to treat someone to a drink.
You might even be invited for a cup yourself!
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I place an order in the cafe?

get_tutorialcontent:
When visiting a Starmigo's planet, <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] the Visit Bar</color> to return home.
If permission is granted, you can use all tools and access a temporary Backpack to store collected resources.
When you leave or end the visit, items in the temporary Backpack will be transferred to your inventory.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I visit?

get_tutorialcontent:
Beat Boogie is a score-based team challenge that tests your rhythm and memory.
Before starting the challenge, <color=#be6106>adjust your volume</color> to make sure you can hear the music clearly.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I play Beat Boogie?

get_tutorialcontent:
During Beat Boogie, copy the host's moves and perform them to the correct beat.
The challenge alternates between Host Rounds and Challenger Rounds. During a Host Round, watch Aleo closely and remember the moves he performs on each beat.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I play Beat Boogie?

get_tutorialcontent: During the challenger's turn, press the corresponding buttons on the correct beat to recreate the host's moves from memory and score points.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I play Beat Boogie?

get_tutorialcontent:
Bazaar Jellies are a popular currency in the Bazaar.
Participating in any Bazaar activity rewards you with <color=#be6106>Bazaar Jellies</color>.
You can redeem them at the <color=#be6106>Prize Kiosk</color> near the stage.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I redeem gifts with Bazaar Jellies?

get_tutorialcontent:
You may occasionally spot a passing <color=#be6106>Starmigo's planet</color> in the sky. Look toward it and <color=#be6106>stargaze</color> in its direction to view its <color=#be6106>details</color>.
On the details screen, you can <color=#be6106>visit</color> and <color=#be6106>add them as a friend</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I check passing planets?

get_tutorialcontent:
Talk to Elsasani and head to the Galactic Bazaar.
Find <color=#be6106>Cafe Untamed</color> near the hillside to the right of the stage and enter it.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I chat in the cafe?

get_tutorialcontent:
While holding an instrument, <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the guitar button][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_LeftMouse.png>]</color> to start playing.
You can also <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#press <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_T.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the note button]</color> to switch to note input mode.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I play an instrument?

get_tutorialcontent:
<color=#be6106>Approach the signpost</color> to open the station's Visitor Management.
Here, you can manage <color=#be6106>permissions</color> and check <color=#be6106>visitor history</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I manage visitor permissions at the Station?

get_tutorialcontent:
When your Acquaintance's Starlight is fully lit, you can gift a Friendship Bouquet <color=#be6106>in person</color> or <color=#be6106>by letter</color> to become Friends.
As Friends, your skies become connected, and you remain in each other's Yoohoo list. Through interactions such as leaving messages, visiting each other, using Reactions, taking photos, chatting, and joining activities together, new patterns begin to form across your planets.
Over time, this shared Starlight forms a radiant ring, drawing your skies even closer together.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I become Friends with someone?

get_tutorialcontent: Without interaction, their Starlight will gradually fade and may <color=#be6106>disappear</color> from your sky.
get_tutorialgroupname: Why does Starlight fade?

get_tutorialcontent:
Acquaintances begin as strangers, leaving traces of Starlight in each other's skies.
In the Galactic Bazaar, scan a stranger's code to connect and become Acquaintances.
Keep <color=#be6106>interacting</color> to strengthen your bond, and their Starlight will shine even brighter.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Acquaintances

get_tutorialcontent:
1. As a visitor, you can purchase items from the owner's <color=#be6106>Trading Rack</color>.
2. Daily purchases are limited. Please choose wisely.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use the Trading Rack?

get_tutorialcontent:
A Friend is someone you come to know over time beneath the stars as their Starlight is lit.
Interact with an Acquaintance, and once their Starlight is fully lit, they can become your <color=#be6106>Friend</color>.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Friends

get_tutorialcontent: If anyone in the <color=#be6106>same round</color> of the Hat-Trick Magic Wheel guesses the gold number, all players <color=#be6106>in that round</color> receive a bonus reward.
get_tutorialgroupname: Surprise! Share the Gold Prize!

get_tutorialcontent: When the countdown ends, claim your Magic Wheel prize from the <color=#be6106>prize pile</color> next to Civilla.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I claim rewards from the Hat-Trick Magic Wheel?

get_tutorialcontent:
The Hat-Trick Magic Wheel is Civilla's game.
Talk to Civilla and use <color=#be6106>Hat-Trick Magic Tickets</color> to join the game and guess a number.
The wheel reveals 1 Gold number, 2 Silver numbers, and 3 Bronze numbers.
When the countdown ends, the closer your chosen number is to the Gold number, the better the reward.
The more Hat-Trick Magic Tickets you use, the more rewards you get. Tickets can be redeemed with Bazaar Jellies at the Prize Kiosk.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I join the Hat-Trick Magic Wheel?
How do I play an instrument?

get_tutorialcontent:
Trading Racks are provided by Loomix Co. to people across the Starsea, encouraging the exchange of goods through goodwill.
1. As a seller, you can list selected items for sale on the <color=#be6106>Trading Rack</color>.
2. Increase your total sales to redeem upgraded Trading Racks from <color=#be6106>Fella</color> at the Galactic Bazaar.
3. Each slot allows only one type of item to be listed per day.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use the Trading Rack?

get_tutorialcontent:
Arable land on each planet requires Luca for crops to grow well.
Each planet starts with a limit of 27 plots. Water the Luca Arbor with jars of Luca to help the planet grow and increase the number of available plots.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I increase the plot limit?

get_tutorialcontent:
The more materials you use, and the higher their quality, the more fertilizer you'll produce.

Different types of materials may yield different types of fertilizer:
Food materials are more likely to produce yield fertilizers, increasing the chance of growing multiple fruits.
Plant materials are more likely to produce vigor fertilizers, which improve the quality of the harvest.
Creature materials are more likely to produce maturity fertilizers, reducing growth time (does not apply to crops that mature in less than one day).

Choose your materials based on your crops' needs to mix the right fertilizer.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I mix materials to create different fertilizers?

get_tutorialcontent:
You can mix fertilizer using a <color=#be6106>Composter</color>.
Add common materials like Broken Wood and Broken Seashells, or natural products such as plants, creatures, fruits, and mushrooms to the Composter. They will ferment overnight and yield various fertilizer mixes the next day.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I mix fertilizer?

get_tutorialcontent:
Open your Backpack, select a fertilizer, and [LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap][LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click] <color=#be6106>Use</color> to add it to your Watering Bucket.
Using the Watering Bucket will now water and fertilize at the same time.
You can also use Precision Farming mode to select a fertilizer before using the Watering Bucket.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I use fertilizer?

get_tutorialcontent:
Mix ingredients to craft different fertilizers.

<color=#be6106>YieldBoost Fertilizer</color>: Increases the chance of higher yields, but has no effect on Plump or Dreamcrown crops.
<color=#be6106>QualityPro Fertilizer</color>: Increases the chance of growing higher-quality crops.
<color=#be6106>FastGro Fertilizer</color>: Reduces crop growth time, but has no effect on crops that mature in a single day.
get_tutorialgroupname: What types of fertilizer are available?

get_tutorialcontent:
Fertilizers improve soil fertility, helping crops grow better. Different types of fertilizer provide different effects.

Each crop can have only one type of fertilizer applied at a time.
Each crop can be fertilized once per harvest.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Fertilizer

get_tutorialcontent:
The Ol' Trusty Scarecrow can help watch over your fields.
Place it near your plots, then approach it to open the Field Management panel and view crop information for all connected plots nearby.
get_tutorialgroupname: About the Ol' Trusty Scarecrow

get_tutorialcontent:
Select the Watering Bucket from the <color=#be6106>Tool Wheel</color>.
Face the plot and <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_LeftMouse.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the Watering Bucket button]</color> to water it.
You can <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#press <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_T.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the button]</color> to enter Precision Farming Mode.
The Watering Bucket can water up to 3 tiles at once. After watering, the soil becomes moist.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I water plants?

get_tutorialcontent:
Dreamcrown crops are more likely to appear near Plump and Strange crops.
If both <color=#be6106>Plump and Strange crops of the same type</color> are fully grown within <color=#be6106>four adjacent plots</color>, nearby crops may grow into the highest-tier crop: Dreamcrown crops.
Dreamcrown crops absorb nutrients from the surrounding four plots.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I grow Dreamcrown crops?

get_tutorialcontent:
Planting different crops next to each other, known as <color=#be6106>interplanting</color>, increases the chance of growing Strange crops.
Water these interplanted plots daily, and they may yield Strange harvests with unique colors or shapes once mature.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I grow Strange crops?

get_tutorialcontent:
You have a higher chance of harvesting Plump crops through <color=#be6106>group planting</color>.
To practice group planting, simply plant the same type of crops next to each other.
Watering these group-planted plots daily may result in unusually large Plump crops once they mature.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I grow Plump crops?

get_tutorialcontent:
1. Hold a <color=#be6106>seed packet</color> to sow multiple plots at once.
2. In Precision Farming Mode, you can sow up to three plots in front of you at a time.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I sow multiple plots at once?
How do I plant crops?

get_tutorialcontent:
Before planting, you need to buy seed packets from the shop.
Select the Shovel from the <color=#be6106>Tool Wheel</color>.
<color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#Press <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_T.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#Tap the button]</color> to enter Precision Farming mode.
Select a seed packet from your Backpack, face the plot you want to cultivate, and <color=#be6106>[LAYOUT_KEYMOUSE#click <dynamicsprite=UISprite/Load/Common/ShortCut/PC/KeyIcon_LeftMouse.png>][LAYOUT_TOUCH#tap the shovel button]</color> to plant it.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I plant crops?

get_tutorialcontent:
Flower breeding allows you to grow flowers in a wider variety of colors to decorate your planet or use for hair dyeing.
Plant flowers of the <color=#be6106>same species</color> next to each other and <color=#be6106>water them every day</color>. When a new day begins, there is a chance that a new flower will grow in an adjacent empty space, possibly in a <color=#be6106>rarer color</color>.
Having visitors or Neighbors water the flowers will increase the chance of breeding a new color.
Only certain color combinations can produce new colors. Try experimenting with different combinations to discover which ones work.
get_tutorialgroupname: How do I breed flowers?

get_tutorialcontent:
When fields are left dry for too long, <color=#be6106>pests</color> may appear when crops mature, reducing the chance of high-quality yields.
When they appear, you can catch them using the Insect Net.
Keep your fields watered to maintain moisture and prevent pests.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Pests

get_tutorialcontent: Rare-colored flowers are delicate. After being harvested several times, they will revert to a common color of the same species.
get_tutorialgroupname: About Flower Color Reversion
